purpose: Broaden Stage 0 Aseprite/LibreSprite chunk coverage beyond the palette/slice subset by proving linked Cel Chunk 0x2005 type 1 target resolution in a deterministic three-frame, three-layer carrier, without claiming tilemap, arbitrary schema, or live external editor coverage.

external_anchors.used_for: ASE Cel Chunk 0x2005 linked cel type 1 layout and frame-position target field, plus Palette Chunk 0x2019, Slice Chunk 0x2022, Layer Chunk 0x2004, Tags Chunk 0x2018, User Data Chunk 0x2020, and compressed Cel Chunk 0x2005 layout.
LibreSprite remains a compatibility boundary; no GPL editor code is embedded.

limitations: Stage 0 Aseprite/LibreSprite linked-cel proof covers Cel Chunk 0x2005 linked cel type 1 targets layered over palette, slice, tag, and semantic layer carrier chunks.
Linked cels are resolved only to same-layer compressed RGBA targets inside this deterministic three-frame subset.
Live external editor rewrite validation is not verified by this lab.
Arbitrary Aseprite project schemas, tilemaps, tilesets, nested groups, advanced timeline variants, and full project-format coverage remain separate.
